say:1:1035811001:1.source_cn: 比起生气，这件事更令人忧心。

say:2:1035811002:1.text: The Sun Temple is full of dangers. With the portal down, our ability to reinforce or retreat is reduced.
say:2:1035811002:1.source_cn: 日神殿内危机重重，传送门的破坏势必会影响后续的增援或是撤离。
